title: Steelers rookie Gennings Dunker adjusting to seeing "a lot faster" NFL players

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers rookie Gennings Dunker adjusting to seeing "a lot faster" NFL players
sources.description: Steelers rookie guard Gennings Dunker hasn't put the pads on for an NFL practice yet, but he's already noticing differences between college and pro football players.
